part3_comparison_old_vs_new.B_new_local_discovery_pipeline: transfer_index-based (broader table than creator_funders), calibrated HIGH-confidence tier (B2Z-P2/P3B-validated 3600s/dust/extraction-failure criteria), CREATE_CREATOR and MIGRATION_SIGNER as explicit SEPARATE roles, deterministic rule-based family classification (STRONG/PARTIAL/AMBIGUOUS/SERVICE_DISTRIBUTION/NOISE), did NOT consult CEX/infra classification until this reconciliation
part3_comparison_old_vs_new.C_ep3_ep4: topology/motif canonicalization (14,203 candidates -> 1,379 motifs), operates on a different evidence representation (motif/relationship graphs), non-authoritative by design (no identity, no canonical claim -- per its own documented contract)
part3_comparison_old_vs_new.D_b2z_selective_verification: raw RPC confirms/contradicts a SPECIFIC local claim (creator+signature+amount+timing) -- evidence UPGRADE mechanism, not a discovery mechanism itself
part3_comparison_old_vs_new.overlapping_evidence: both A and B use direct-funder relationships and timing; both apply a CEX-exclusion concept (A via is_cex column filter, B did NOT until this reconciliation -- GAP IDENTIFIED AND NOW CLOSED)
part3_comparison_old_vs_new.unique_to_A: WATCHTOWER-specific known infrastructure signatures (birth amount bands, dual-signaller timing), structural burst-detection identity-agnostic fallback
part3_comparison_old_vs_new.unique_to_B: MIGRATION_SIGNER as a distinct evidence role, 2-hop composite-family detection (independent signal agreement), calibrated (measured, not assumed) confidence thresholds
part3_comparison_old_vs_new.conflicting_semantics: NONE material -- both use CANDIDATE-vs-CONFIRMED-equivalent two-tier authority; B's classification vocabulary differs (STRONG/PARTIAL/etc vs CANDIDATE/CONFIRMED) but maps cleanly (STRONG/PARTIAL == CANDIDATE-tier, no B-side CONFIRMED authority exists or is claimed)
part3_comparison_old_vs_new.duplicated_logic: burst/fan-out detection exists in BOTH A (_discover_structural_provisioners) and B (mega-hub demotion rule) -- functionally analogous, independently arrived at, not literally duplicated code
part3_comparison_old_vs_new.provenance_strength: A has WATCHTOWER-specific ground truth (exact known signatures); B has broader population coverage but weaker per-relationship certainty (candidate-only, calibration-validated but not individually RPC-confirmed) -- A is authoritative for WATCHTOWER-related structure, B is exploratory for NEW/unknown structure
part3_comparison_old_vs_new.authority_conclusion: NEITHER method replaces the other. A remains authoritative for Watchtower-specific canonical determination. B is a NEW, broader, provider-free discovery layer for candidates A's WATCHTOWER-specific signatures cannot see. Neither claims exclusive authority over canonical attribution -- that remains a separate, human-reviewed step in both.
